name: Veronika Cifrová Ostrihoňová - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on public access to documents – report covering the years 2022 - 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament says access to EU documents is a basic right and should be the norm, not the exception. It asks the European Commission to propose a new, stronger law on public access, because the old rules from 2001 are outdated and two earlier reform attempts were withdrawn. It also asks the Commission and the Council to stop delaying answers, stop over-classifying documents, and publish more legislative documents proactively.

- The report is an opinion; it does not itself change any law.
- It targets the European Commission, the Council and other EU bodies.
- Next: the Commission is asked to draft a new access-to-documents law.
